faq_heading: Tsawwassen Central houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Tsawwassen Central sell for?
faq.a: 34 houses sold in Tsawwassen Central between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,472,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Tsawwassen Central?
faq.a: The median was 17 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.8% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Tsawwassen Central sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 34 houses that sold in Tsawwassen Central went for between $1,273,000 and $1,665,500, around a median of $1,472,500.

faq.q: Do houses in Tsawwassen Central sell above asking price?
faq.a: 9% of the 34 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.8% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Tsawwassen Central?
faq.a: The median year built was 1969 for the 34 houses sold in Tsawwassen Central.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Tsawwassen Central usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Tsawwassen Central had 5 bedrooms, from the 34 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Tsawwassen Central houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

34 houses sold in Tsawwassen Central with a median price of $1,472,500 (the middle half sold between $1,273,000 and $1,665,500), taking a median of 17 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $558 per square foot, a median year built of 1969 and a median lot of 8,988 square feet.
How Tsawwassen Central compares with the rest of Tsawwassen

The median house in Tsawwassen Central sold for $1,472,500, about the same as the Tsawwassen median of $1,499,500 across 158 sales. Tsawwassen Central houses took a median 17 days to sell, against 20 days for Tsawwassen as a whole.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a community is listed only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.
